scope: actual built AppState hooks and Cloud authorization wrapper, readonly shared schema, ledger, task scope and bridge; minimal AI-only identity and no Cloud account/instance/capability; isolated synthetic storage

tests.name: AI-only native actor is invalid outside the scope but current category IMPORT schema loads inside it
AI-only administrator commits one unified DIRECT record with actual normalized custom fields and no Cloud grant
readonly AI-only task records can be read without enabling import, Cloud menus or schema maintenance
AI-only unknown import keeps one receipt and task-scoped reconciliation works after task and scene become unavailable
a task-source change rejects a prechecked manual import token without writing the ledger
an API task cannot adopt a manual scene to mix sources
scoped action names cannot be used to start calls, perform ordinary imports or change schema/configuration
source page, import grant, current identity and synchronous finally boundaries cannot be bypassed
